name: Visual Basic
title: Visual Basic (6.0)

presenceList.meta: Ec4, Ec5, Ec7, V3, D1, D3, S1, Q3

type.text: **`Implements` decouples the caller from the class**: A class can implement an interface without inheriting an implementation
**Undeclared variables are `Variant`**: `Option Explicit` is opt-in, so a name can accept anything
**There are no namespaces**: Every public name in a project shares one global scope
**There are no generics**: A collection holds `Variant`, and a read is a cast
**COM dispatch resolves at run time**: `IDispatch` and `TypeOf` reach a member by name
**An object variable can be `Nothing`**: Nothing in the type says whether it is set
**There is no sum type**: A closed set of cases is an enum or a set of constants, and a `Select Case` is not checked for exhaustiveness

construction.text: **`Class_Initialize` is the constructor**: The object states its own setup
**A module-level variable is global**: A public variable in a `.bas` module is reachable from the whole project
**A property is read/write by default**: A field is mutable unless the author writes a getter only

memory.text: **Objects are reference-counted**: The last released reference frees the object, so release is deterministic
**A reference cycle leaks**: Two objects that point at each other are never freed

error.text: **`On Error GoTo` is the failure path**: The failure travels by a jump and a global `Err` object, and no signature states it
**`On Error Resume Next` is explicit**: The skip is written at the site

concurrency.text: **An ActiveX EXE can run a unit out of process**: The mechanism is a separate component
**There is no first-class thread or channel**: Concurrency is a COM apartment and a separate process

platform.text: **A program runs on Windows through COM**: The registry, the apartment, and the binary format are the platform
**The VB6 runtime must be installed**: `msvbvm60.dll` ships with the operating system, not with the program

performance.text: **The compiler emits native code**: A project can be built to a native executable
**Late binding is slow**: An `IDispatch` call resolves a name at run time

ecosystem.text: **The platform is proprietary**: Visual Studio 6 and the VB6 runtime are Microsoft products
**The IDE is locked to Windows**: The designer and the debugger are Windows applications
**A large body of VB6 code remains**: A component written in 1998 still runs on a supported Windows
**The component model is standard**: An ActiveX control or a COM server is callable from any COM client
A component publishes a COM type library, the platform's binary interface for its consumers [@comTypelib]

evolution.text: **The language is frozen at 6.0**: No release after it changes the language
**The line is discontinued**: Support ended in 2008, and no successor accepts the source

domain.text: **The centre is the Windows desktop and COM**: A line-of-business form over a database
**The form and the event set the architecture**: A program is a set of controls and handlers

learning.text: **The language is small and widely taught**: BASIC syntax and a drag-and-drop designer

syntax.text: **`Dim`, `Set`, and `End If` are spelled out**: The declaration and the block are verbose
**The default-property syntax is dated**: `Text1.Text` and the line-continuation underscore

testing.text: **The IDE debugs in place**: Breakpoints, watches, and the immediate window

security.text: **A `Variant` hides the type until run time**
**ADO and dynamic SQL take a string**: A `WHERE` clause built by concatenation is an injection path

reproducibility.text: **The project build is not reproducible**: A `.vbp` build embeds paths and a timestamp
**A dependency is a registered DLL**: Nothing in the project pins the component version

supplychain.text: **A component carries no signature**: Registration is a registry entry

observability.text: **There is no tracing standard**: A program writes a file or the event log
**There is no structured logging facility**: Output is a string

feedback.text: **The IDE reports a syntax error as it is typed**

interop.text: **There is no portable target**: A binary runs on Windows only

governance.text: **One vendor governs the language**: Microsoft defines the runtime and the tooling
**The specification is a vendor document**: The language is documented, not standardised

tradeoffs: **A `Variant` default buys speed of writing**: An undeclared variable accepts anything, and the type error arrives at run time
**COM is a real boundary**: A server is called through an interface, and the implementation is replaceable
**Reference counting is deterministic but fragile**: A cycle leaks, and the release order is the program's to know
**The language is frozen**: A program written for 6.0 will not move to a modern runtime unchanged
verdict: Visual Basic 6 is a form-and-COM language: the interface and the component model decouple a caller, and reference counting frees an object deterministically, but the default `Variant`, the flat namespace, `On Error GoTo`, and the Windows-only runtime keep the coupling high. Main strength: a small language with a real component boundary. Main weakness: the failure path is a jump, and the program runs only inside COM on Windows.

energy.text: No independent energy or time benchmark for the language is recorded.

ai-readiness.text: Sparse public training data: models write it less reliably than a mainstream language [@joel2025lowresource].

safety.text: No certified or standards-qualified path for safety-critical systems.

delivery.note: A component publishes a COM type library, the platform's binary interface for its consumers
